name: @latticekit/example-replay
description: REPLAY — a gallery exhibit. Record, scrub, and prove it: the same seed and log land on the same pixel.
$comment: Seven of nine. `sim` has no economy to run and `audio` would start making noise before a visitor has touched anything, which the gallery has no shared answer for yet. The other five are the exhibit: `input` records, `persist` stores and verifies, `loop` drives, and `iso`/`draw`/`ui` put it on screen. `persist` is used for a replay log rather than for progress — nothing here outlives the tab, because the store's adapter is memoryStorage().
